patterns.title: Pattern 1: Kanji Reading (漢字の読み方)
patterns.description: Tests your ability to accurately select the correct Hiragana reading for underlined Kanji words in realistic sentences.
patterns.strategy: Pay close attention to long vowels (お vs おう, え vs えい), small っ (sokuon), and voiced consonants (tenten が/ざ/だ/ば/ぱ).

patterns.title: Pattern 2: Kanji Orthography (表記・漢字選び)
patterns.description: Given a sentence with a Hiragana word, identify the correct Kanji representation from visual distractor characters.
patterns.strategy: Distinguish between visually similar radicals (e.g., 待つ to wait vs 持つ to hold; 言 to speak vs 計 to measure; 書 vs 昼).

patterns.title: Pattern 3: Contextual Vocabulary Choice (文脈規定)
patterns.description: Choose the most logically and contextually appropriate noun, verb, or adverb that fits inside the sentence blank.
patterns.strategy: Read the whole sentence first before looking at choices. Look for collocation pairs (e.g. 傘をさす, 薬を飲む, 電気を消す, 鍵をかける).

patterns.title: Pattern 4: Paraphrasing & Synonyms (言い換え類義語)
patterns.description: Identify which phrase or sentence conveys the exact same meaning as the underlined word.
patterns.strategy: Focus on the core intent: e.g. 気をつけて -> 注意して; だいたい -> およそ; 遠慮しないで -> 気を使わないで; 確かめる -> 確認する.

patterns.title: Pattern 5: Grammar Forms & Particles (文法形式の判断)
patterns.description: Fill the blank with correct particles (は, が, を, に, で, へ, と, より) or verb conjugation forms (Te-form, Passive, Causative, Potential, Conditional).
patterns.strategy: Check the verb following the particle. Destination takes に/へ, active action at location takes で, passive takes に/から, ability takes が.

patterns.title: Pattern 6: Star ★ Sentence Ordering (文の組み立て・★問題)
patterns.description: Reorder 4 scrambled phrase fragments: ＿＿ ＿＿ ★ ＿＿ to form a natural grammatical sentence, then pick the phrase that belongs on the star (★)!
patterns.strategy: Form smaller 2-word collocations first. Look at the end of the sentence to see what verb form is needed, and connect modifiers before nouns.

patterns.title: Pattern 7: Workplace & Daily Can-Do Dialogues (会話表現・やりとり)
patterns.description: Select natural, polite conversational responses for workplace shifts, shopping, apologies, and asking permissions.
patterns.strategy: Evaluate social hierarchy: talking to a manager vs coworker. Use 〜てもいいですか for permission, お疲れ様です for shifts, 承知いたしました for requests.

patterns.title: Pattern 8: Notices, Emails & Short Memos (短文・掲示読解)
patterns.description: Comprehend real apartment notices, clinic hours, work emails, and instruction flyers.
patterns.strategy: Read the question first to know what target info (date, price, condition) to scan for in the text.

patterns.title: Pattern 9: Information Retrieval & Schedules (情報検索・時刻表・表)
patterns.description: Extract specific details from garbage disposal calendars, train timetables, discount coupons, and event posters.
patterns.strategy: Check footnotes, asterisk (*) conditions, day-of-the-week restrictions, and conditions that apply to specific groups.
